book.title: 1934: Caught in the Crossroads
book.tagline: A relic from the Crusades resurfaces, threatening a world already on the brink.
description: Europe, 1934. The scars of the Great War have not healed, and something older has begun to surface beneath the politics of the age.

When an archaeological discovery in Yugoslavia points toward a lost fragment of the True Cross, Nazi operatives move quickly to seize it. Four unlikely allies are drawn into a race across a continent sliding toward catastrophe.
Their search leads through archives, ruins, monasteries, and hidden histories — but the relic is more than an artifact. In the wrong hands, it could become a weapon of power, myth, and belief.
1934: Caught in the Crossroads is a historical thriller about ideology, memory, and the people caught between the collapsing world behind them and the one rushing forward to replace it.
